channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Director Of Black Hockey Documentary 'Soul On Ice' Reflects On Its Impact 10 Years Later
item.description: Kwame Mason's debut film continues to have an impact on the hockey world when it comes to showing the importance of the Black hockey story from the game's past, present, and looking forward to its future with diverse talent.

item.title: Three NHL Trade Deadline Predictions: Biggest Return, Surprise Buyers, And More
item.description: The NHL's trade deadline is under a week away. That means it's time for some bold predictions as to what we'll see on the trade front by the deadline. Which teams will dominate the trade market? Which veteran players will get the biggest trade return this year?

item.title: Calder Trophy Is Schaefer's To Lose, With Respect To Habs' Demidov And Ducks' Sennecke
item.description: The Calder Trophy is New York Islanders defenseman Matthew Schaefer's to lose, despite impressive rookie campaigns from Montreal Canadiens right winger Ivan Demidov and Anaheim Ducks right winger Beckett Sennecke.

item.title: Red Wings, Canucks Await On Tyler Myers' Decision To Be Traded To Detroit
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings have a trade offer on the table for Vancouver Canucks defenseman Tyler Myers. Since Myers has trade protection in his contract, it'll be the players' decision whether he gets moved to Detroit or stays in Vancouver.

item.title: 'Decent Chance' Blues Move Robert Thomas Ahead Of Trade Deadline, Per NHL Insider
item.description: Sportsnet insider Elliotte Friedman says there is a "decent chance" that St. Louis Blues star center Robert Thomas gets moved ahead of Friday's NHL trade deadline.

item.title: Maple Leafs Can Address The Oilers' Defensive And Center Needs
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers are reportedly looking for a defenseman to play the right side and a third-line center. The Toronto Maple Leafs can grant Edmonton's wishes in one transaction, with whom could be available at the NHL trade deadline.

item.title: Kings Fire Jim Hiller, D.J. Smith Becomes Interim Head Coach
item.description: The Los Angeles Kings have fired head coach Jim Hiller after 175 games behind the bench. Former Ottawa Senators bench boss D.J. Smith comes in as interim coach, and Matt Greene joins the staff as assistant coach.

item.title: NHL Waivers: Oilers Place Mangiapane And Regula On The Wire, Three Other Teams Active
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers placed Andrew Mangiapane and Alec Regula on waivers. The Vancouver Canucks, St. Louis Blues and Florida Panthers have also been active on Sunday's waiver wire.

item.title: NHL's Top Four Defenseman Trade Candidates Ahead Of Deadline
item.description: With the NHL trade deadline less than one week away, here are four of the top defensemen who could be available on the trade block.

item.title: Maple Leafs' Berube's Post-Game Comments Suggest His Days Are Numbered
item.description: After the Toronto Maple Leafs put in an abysmal performance in their 5-2 loss to the Ottawa Senators on Saturday, Leafs coach Craig Berube publicly questioned his players' heart and mind. Do Berube's post-game comments suggest a coaching change is on the way?
